name: io.github.herp75/mcp-cookidoo
description: Thermomix Cookidoo: search recipes, manage custom recipes, shopping list, meal plan, collections

environmentVariables.name: COOKIDOO_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Cookidoo account password (use a unique one)

environmentVariables.name: COOKIDOO_COUNTRY
environmentVariables.description: Cookidoo site country code, e.g. ch, de, fr (default fr)

environmentVariables.name: COOKIDOO_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Cookidoo site language, e.g. de-CH, de-DE, fr-FR (default fr-FR)

environmentVariables.name: COOKIDOO_DEVICE
environmentVariables.description: Thermomix recipes are written for: TM5, TM6 or TM7 (default: detected)

environmentVariables.name: COOKIDOO_IMAGE_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Folders upload_custom_recipe_image may read, ':'-separated; in the container, mount them read-only (default: upload disabled)
